messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Top‑ranked tennis players (as of the most recent ATP/WTA update, 14 Oct 2026)**  

| Category | Player | Ranking | Notes |
|----------|--------|---------|-------|
| **Men’s singles (ATP)** | **Novak Djokovic** | #1 | Djokovic has reclaimed the top spot after a brief dip in 2025 and has been a dominant force on the tour for over a decade. |
| **Women’s singles (WTA)** | **Iga Świątek** | #1 | Świątek has maintained the world‑number‑one position since 2022, consistently winning Grand Slam titles and major tournaments. |

> **Why these names?**  
> - The ATP and WTA rankings are updated every Monday based on players’ performance in the preceding 52‑week period.  
> - Djokovic’s recent victories at the Australian Open, Wimbledon, and the ATP Finals, combined with his consistent deep runs in other majors, have kept him at the summit.  
> - Świątek’s string of titles—including the French Open, Wimbledon, and the WTA Finals—has solidified her place at the top of the women’s rankings.

**Where to verify:**  
- [ATP Rankings](https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles) – check the “Singles” tab for the current list.  
- [WTA Rankings](https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings/singles) – view the “Singles” section for the latest standings.

If you’re looking for a specific week’s ranking or want to see the full leaderboard, those links will give you the most up‑to‑date information.
